scope: Read-only live-campaign projection and UI; no Worker, simulation, AI, RNG, persistence schema, or old-save migration change.

truthContract.currentCampaign: endedTick is null and bound relationId is currently war
truthContract.completeHistory: current participants, declaration by warId, goals and openedTick are shown
truthContract.unknownHistory: does not invent attacker, defender, reason, original goal, or original start date
truthContract.losses: native deaths grouped by current/historical side; explicitly original score units, not fatalities
truthContract.sieges: global current active display-frame count only; no campaign-specific attribution
truthContract.territoryTransfers: not attributed by campaign; complete ledger remains the source
